svg.text: Relay placement study, rev C unit (3 radios × 4 antennas + EXP), 1:1 grid in mm, view from the component side
Red: rows on top copper. Blue and purple: columns and feeds on bottom copper (dashed purple: top). The THT relay pins make the layer change.
Logic zone: I2C expanders (37 outputs + inputs), low-side drivers, /RLY_EN high-side switches, 3V3 LDO, fuses
Antenna ports: K1 (COM ant, NO column, NC ground via bleed), static bleed, GDT footprint (not fitted), RF detector, bias-T option
SO-239 strap and GND-boss zone (10 mm)
34 fitted (3 K0, 12 TX, 15 RX incl. EXP, 4 K1)
3 TX at A2 not fitted: A2 receive-only (D-103)
W 2.7 mm, gap 2.0 mm, band 9 mm
top: XT60 ×2, XT30, RJ45 LINK, RJ45 EXP CTRL
about 0.16 pF each; about 60 dB at 30 MHz
S1–S6 NPTH M3 (not on GND) + 7 SO-239 GND bosses
RT1 open-contact isolation at 30 MHz: to measure
with the NanoVNA-H4 (not in the datasheet).
RF band 9 mm: W 2.7, gaps 2.0, fence 3.9 mm from centre.
Coil drivers and expanders fit in the 32 mm logic zone.
Feeds at x 72, 81, 90 (9 mm pitch); R3 straight up.
